reviews.title: Nice for the price
reviews.comment:
Works for my husband PC components. Solid case, large enough to fit larger GPUs with ease, and nice clean look. Not too pricey imo.
Cools well with the fans my husband has.

reviews.title: 011 vision review
reviews.comment: I just had my computer components installed into this Beauty of a Beast and I would give it 10 out of 10. it's fool proof and very simplified. Best PC tower i seen yet I definitely recommend this tower for everyone. the only downside I would say is that it's a little heavy when everything is installed i would say it weighs 5-10lbs closer to 10lbs
